sections.advice: Treat High point near Sérifontaine → Food stop near Évreux as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.

sections.advice: Scenic stretch near La Chapelle-la-Reine → Photo stop near Sergines is the reward section in Paris. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.
Photo stop near Sergines → Argenteuil is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

richardson-highway-valdez-delta-junction.title: Richardson Highway: Valdez to Delta Junction
richardson-highway-valdez-delta-junction.slogan: Valdez to Delta Junction - a long day on the Richardson Highway · one way, about 866 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Valdez
waypoints.advice: Valdez is where the day begins. Next is Thompson Pass.

waypoints.name: Thompson Pass
waypoints.advice: Thompson Pass comes up 217 km in. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Worthington Glacier, mostly downhill.

waypoints.advice: 433 km in you reach Worthington Glacier. Next is Glennallen.

sections.advice: Valdez → Thompson Pass climbs about 855 m in 42 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Thompson Pass → Worthington Glacier drops about 855 m over 4 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Worthington Glacier → Glennallen is 131 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Glennallen → Delta Junction is 268 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

scenicChapters.title: Valdez → Thompson Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 81 km. 855 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Richardson Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: 855 m come off over 7 km at around 22.8%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

richardson-highway-valdez-delta-junction.story: 866 km from Valdez to the finish, about 11 h 58 of riding. On the way it passes Thompson Pass, Worthington Glacier and Glennallen. The highest point is about 1,200 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
